task.title: Fix batch outreach JSON parsing to be robust
task.description: In the batch outreach function (runBatch), there are two places using fragile JSON parsing with charCodeAt(0)===96 check. Replace both with robust parsing. For the filter step response: let txt=filterData.content[0].text.trim(); txt=txt.replace(/^```(?:json)?\s*/i,'').replace(/\s*```\s*$/,'').trim(); const jsonMatch=txt.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if(!jsonMatch) throw new Error('No JSON in filter response'); const filterResult=JSON.parse(jsonMatch[0]); For each per-contact generation step: let txt=data.content[0].text.trim(); txt=txt.replace(/^```(?:json)?\s*/i,'').replace(/\s*```\s*$/,'').trim(); const jsonMatch=txt.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if(!jsonMatch){failed++;log('Batch: no JSON for '+c.name);continue;} const parsed=JSON.parse(jsonMatch[0]); Also in the catch block for per-contact generation, log which contact failed: console.warn('Batch generation failed for '+c.name+':',e.message);
